ns2:course.label: Astronomy Laboratory
ns2:course.description: Provides hands-on observational experience: how to use a telescope, how to image sources using a modern CCD camera, how to use a modern CCD spectrometer, and how to apply data analysis to astrophysical problems. 2 undergraduate hours. 2 graduate hours. Prerequisite: One 400-level astronomy course.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 2 undergraduate hours. 2 graduate hours. Prerequisite: One 400-level astronomy course.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Astronomy or Computer Sci & Astronomy or Astrophysics or Astronomy + Data Science major(s) or minor(s).
